description: This PHP class represents a summary of pending leave requests within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It constructs search filter parameters based on accessible employee numbers and retrieves the count of pending leave requests that need approval.

classes.name: PendingLeaveRequestSummary
classes.description: A class that summarizes pending leave requests to approve, identifying the group ID, group name, and count of pending requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the summary object with accessible employee numbers, setting up appropriate search filter parameters.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the group of leave requests to approve.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group for display purposes.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of leave requests pending approval based on the search filter parameters.
